verdict.rationale: Power and cooling specs are a fair axis for a graphics card, but the evidence pack has no AMD-published board power, TDP/TGP figure, connector requirement or cooling guidance for the RX 9070 XT. The vendor product page could not be crawled, and the ROCm docs cover only software. The only related item is a community review of one partner card, the Sapphire Nitro+, noting its 16-pin connector and strong cooling. That describes a single custom board, which the reviewer says is unusual among these cards, so it is not a published spec for the card and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a gamer, I can spec a build around published board power — TDP/TGP, connector requirements, and cooling guidance for this exact card
